sources.entry: Gerrit - Code review and project management tool for Git-based projects. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Java/Docker

summary.one_liner: Gerrit is a web-based code review and project management tool for Git-based projects, letting reviewers comment inline on side-by-side diffs and letting authorized users submit changes to a shared repository.
summary.what_it_does: Gerrit shows code changes in a side-by-side display and lets any reviewer add inline comments. It lets any authorized user submit changes to the master Git repository instead of requiring a maintainer to merge approved changes by hand. The README points to external documentation for installation and usage. Binary packages are available for Debian/Ubuntu, CentOS/RedHat and Fedora via GerritForge/BinTray repositories. Pre-built Docker images are published on DockerHub in CentOS 8 and Ubuntu 20.04 variants. The project is built from source with Bazel.
use_cases: Reviewing Git code changes before merging
Inline code commenting by team members
Maintaining Git projects with multiple contributors
Running Gerrit in a Docker container
how_to_run: Install Deb/RPM packages: apt-get install gerrit=<version>-<release> (Debian/Ubuntu), yum install gerrit (CentOS/RedHat), dnf install gerrit (Fedora)
notable: Side-by-side diff review with inline comments from any reviewer
Lets authorized users submit changes directly to the master Git repository
Official Docker images for CentOS 8 and Ubuntu 20.04
Deb/RPM packages for Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS, RedHat and Fedora
caveats: Creating issues and Gerrit changes on the public server requires membership in the repo-discuss Google Group because of spam abuse
Pull requests via the GitHub mirror are not accepted
Installation and usage details are only in external documentation, not the README
